title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin closes flat at $63,012 as fear dominates, with the index at 34. The network shows strength through 918.4 EH/s hashrate and a mempool of 72,000 transactions carrying a 1 sat/vB floor at block 962,656. 

Low volatility into the close points to consolidation, not capitulation. 

Watch overnight for any sentiment shifts or hashrate swings that could set the tone for Asia.
